answer:
The tallest lighthouse in the world, the **Jeddah Lighthouse** (also known as the Jeddah Sea Tower), was completed in **1990**.

It stands at a height of approximately 131–133 meters (431–436 feet) and is located in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Construction took place between 1987 and 1990, after which it replaced an earlier structure and earned its status as the world's tallest lighthouse according to Guinness World Records.
